title: [I17:E01] Skill Style: The Groundwork for Prosiform Compliance
body:
## Overview

Work Planner separates numbered procedures from enriched command specifications. Commands precedes Fields; each command owns its input/output links and invocation, while callers retain selections, guards and result handling. Single-reference artifact operations and redundant command-forwarding operations are part of their callers; shared operations remain with their owning artifacts. Installed declarations select the shared checker and the corpus readers that enforce those boundaries.

## Changes

### Shared Validation

- **Declared models.** Exact-file and family declarations select headings, preambles, command specifications, Field contracts, role tags and Run/Apply/Follow routing.
- **Literal boundaries.** One lexical reader isolates fenced and HTML payloads while recognizing explicit bold command annotations and specification placement.
- **Contract interpretation.** Command specifications own input/output contracts at actual parameter or prose use. Checks reject duplicate nested contracts, redundant forwarding wrappers, repeated parent titles and invocations outside Commands.

### Instruction Corpus

- **Field examples.** Linked Fields own value, payload and output examples written as `eg` with inline code. Structural templates and formatting demonstrations keep their fenced layout. Command specifications carry generic invocations and meaningful usage conditions, including the hot-fix draft flag.
- **Command contracts.** Each command opens with an imperative action and linked provided results and recipient. Its specification retains linked parameters, preconditions and authorization. Nested calls identify meaningful selections and evidence transitions without repeating the parameter inventory. A sole prose condition accompanies the preamble without a bullet; genuine multi-item detail lists follow the invocation.
- **Command presentation.** Shell continuations and line-leading output redirections use HTML entities to preserve literal characters inside one rendered command block. Paths, refs, text and expressions retain required quotes; validated shell-safe values remain unquoted.
- **Common context.** Rules, Conventions and Configuration have focused homes. rules.md defines runtime link roles once; guidelines link that definition.
- **Contained items.** Steps with several instruction/detail items bullet every item; a sole item uses plain prose. Called operations, protocols and procedures carry ƒ; explicit results use Provide.

- **Data contracts.** Fields identify scalars/references, documents, collections or composite objects. Lane exposes separate flat assignment-read, unit-validation and admission results with explicit null, finding and exit semantics. Start evidence is concrete data; queue jurisdiction and lifecycle policy are not implied inputs. The authoring guideline and prerequisite consumer check preserve this distinction.

- **Context through links.** Modes, protocols and artifacts select needed context through in-text links and their reading boundaries. Prerequisites inventories and automatic preload rules are absent. Explicit whole-document instructions, common Rules/Conventions, actual execution gates and delivery dependencies remain.

### Consuming Readers

- **Installed authority.** Corpus readers use the declared specification model and shared role grammar while retaining script-reach, link/contract, literal-exclusion and obligation checks.
- **Checkout propagation.** Checkout acceptance follows authoritative command contracts through procedural calls. Logical command lines retain checkout, revision, registration and publication assertions, including real-git placement tests.

### Instruction Preservation

- **Single-use composition.** Thirty-five artifact operations have one linked reference and are inlined at that caller; 65 remain shared. Record Dispatch Status retains four references. Conditions, loops, decisions and completion handling remain explicit, with corrected readiness/refusal continuations and a corpus reference-count gate. All 116 command specifications remain. Current Fields describe data values; single-use rules are inline and shared policies have one Guidance home. The field sweep preserves every invocation block and nine literal templates against its recorded baseline.
- **Observed regressions.** Comparing the pre-E01 source found empty selection values dropped by shell parsing, missing initiative output and formatter-context flags, a missing post-repair delivery survey, and ambiguous stale-index conditional scope. Command owners and procedures now carry those instructions explicitly.
- **Behavioral evidence.** Documented command fixtures verify optional selections, output paths, reservation dates, repeated base revisions, Development evidence and actual Lane result examples. The current full planner suite runs 946 tests: 945 pass and one opt-in check is skipped. The retired test required duplicate prerequisite inventories. All 280 shared checker tests pass; the installed model reports 58 files and zero findings.
- **Review boundary.** The comparison traces all 116 original generic command specifications, field moves and critical delivery/planning/synchronization gates. It does not establish live tracker or GitNexus correctness. Prerequisite cleanup remains planned in E02, and this integration PR remains draft.

## References

- **R1.** [Skill Models](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/pull/1640) — declared-model validation and specimen coverage.
- **R2.** [Common Files](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/pull/1642) — shared rules, conventions and configuration with their consuming readers.
- **R3.** [Mode Procedures](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/pull/1643) — heading steps, preserved command inputs and maintained readers, with explicit partial disclosure observations.
- **R4.** [Protocol Procedures](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/pull/1644) — heading steps, preserved operative conditions and explicit repeated calls, with separately qualified reading observations.
- **R5.** [Issue and Body Artifacts](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/pull/1646) — linked contracts, executing commands and maintained readers, with separately qualified Partial disclosure.
- **R6.** [Delivery Artifacts](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/pull/1647) — linked contracts, executing commands and maintained readers, with separately qualified Partial disclosure.
- **R7.** [Board, Queue, Planning and Review Artifacts](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/pull/1651) — linked contracts, executing commands and maintained readers, with all six supplementary walks explicitly Partial.
- **R8.** [Installed Work Planner Model](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/pull/1652) — activated declarations, aligned rule homes and installed-model source readers, with exact verification boundaries and Partial disclosure observations.

- **R9.** [Architecture Overview](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-05-1641-skill-style-groundwork/overview.md) — structural graph baseline and reading order for the earlier integration revision; not a measurement of the current command-layout change.
- **R10.** [Agent Review](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-05-1597-next-delivery/integration-agent-review.json) — review of an earlier integration revision; it does not cover the current head.
- **R11.** [Integration Verification](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-05-1597-next-delivery/integration-validation.md) — earlier integration results and reading-trial limits, retained with their recorded source revisions.


- **R12.** [Command Layout Verification](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-command-specifications/validation.md) — migration-stage regression results and preservation against its intermediate baseline, with partial fresh-context reading observations; R13 extends the comparison to the pre-E01 source.

- **R13.** [Pre-E01 Preservation Review](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-instruction-preservation-review/review.md) — original/reviewed/corrected revisions, reproduced regressions, corrections, command/field comparisons, retained gates and verification limits.

- **R14.** [Command Rendering Verification](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-instruction-preservation-review/command-rendering.md) — local reproduction of the blockquote defect, eight corrected invocations with identical decoded shell text, and 34 passing focused checks.

- **R15.** [Imperative Command Preambles](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-command-preambles/validation.md) — all 116 command preambles and the owning guideline; byte-identical invocations, preserved links/conditions/Fields/callers, full regression results and exact source identity.

- **R16.** [Inline Field Example Verification](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-inline-field-examples/validation.md) — 134 converted specimens, preserved scalar/JSON values and command text, the inline-example reader update and complete regression results.

- **R17.** [Single-Use Artifact Operations](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-single-use-operations/validation.md) — full reference inventory, 35 caller compositions, exact command/Field preservation, independent review corrections and final tests. Full reading disclosure remains partial because inherited prerequisite cycles are unwaived; corrected failure routes have separate bounded fresh-context checks.

- **Command tag validation.** [Encoding and rendered-label evidence](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-command-tag-escaping/validation.md): 49 affected commands corrected; all 116 decoded invocations and 463 linked argument labels preserved. Shared checker: 280 passing tests; planner: 943 passed and one opt-in skip; installed model: zero findings.

- **Further complete Markdown fidelity review.** [All-file review and corrections](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-final-fidelity-review/review.md): all 55 original/58 current Markdown files compared; three reproduced defects corrected (reservation date, repeated epic-base revisions, Development snapshot example). Nine literal templates preserved; 116 commands render valid role links. Planner: 946 passed/one opt-in skip; shared checker: 280 passed; installed model: zero findings. Inherited E02/E04 limits remain explicit; no live tracker/graph or complete disclosure conformance claimed.

- **Canonical checkout context.** [Scoped operation/command validation](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-scoped-checkout-context/validation.md): 33 execution-location metadata declarations removed; required checkouts use canonical steps and linked command inputs. Invocation, Fields, template and prerequisite contents preserved. Ten checkout and twelve command tests pass; full planner 944 passed/one skip; installed model zero findings.

- **R18.** [Field Shape Sweep](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-field-shapes/validation.md) — disposition of all 564 original fields, single-owner and shared policy homes, actual Lane output contracts, exact invocation/template preservation, full regression results and separately recorded inherited policy/disclosure limits.

- **R19.** [Single-Condition Preambles](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-single-condition-preambles/validation.md) — four sole detail items beside their preambles, the owning guideline, 28 passing consumer checks and exact invocation/template/heading/link preservation.

- **R20.** [Context Through Links](https://github.com/m2ux/workflow-server/blob/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-11-06-1616-context-links/validation.md) — all 43 prerequisite inventories removed, aligned declarations/guidelines/consumers, exact invocation/template/Fields preservation, full checks and repeated fresh-context routes with explicit retrieval limits.
